points.text: Computes the photon energy E = h f = 6.63 x 10^-34 x 1.20 x 10^15 = 7.96 x 10^-19 J
Applies Einstein's equation KE_max = E - W = 7.96 x 10^-19 - 3.31 x 10^-19 = 4.65 x 10^-19 J

items.prompt: Ultraviolet light of frequency 1.20 x 10^15 Hz strikes a metal of work function 3.31 x 10^-19 J. Calculate the maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electrons, showing your working with Einstein’s photoelectric equation.

points.text: Selects de Broglie's relation lambda = h / (m v) with h = 6.63 x 10^-34, m = 9.11 x 10^-31 kg and v = 1.0 x 10^6 m s^-1
Computes lambda = 6.63 x 10^-34 / (9.11 x 10^-31 x 1.0 x 10^6) = 7.3 x 10^-10 m and states that this wave behaviour of matter is evidence for wave-particle duality

items.prompt: An emitted electron moves at 1.0 x 10^6 m s^-1. Calculate its de Broglie wavelength and say what this wave behaviour of matter is evidence for. (m_e = 9.11 x 10^-31 kg, h = 6.63 x 10^-34 J s)

points.text: Applies Faraday's law: emf = -N x 0.020 / 0.50 = 8.0 V, the minus sign showing the induced emf opposes the change (Lenz's law)

items.prompt: The flux through a 200-turn coil falls from 0.030 Wb to 0.010 Wb in 0.50 s. Calculate the induced emf, showing your working with Faraday's law.

points.text: States that the emf follows the rate of change of flux, not the flux itself

Explains that as the coil turns edge-on the flux passes through zero but is changing fastest there, so the emf peaks, and half a turn later the flux changes the other way so the emf reverses and alternates

items.prompt: In the generator scene the coil spins steadily in a magnetic field. Explain why the induced emf is greatest when the flux through the coil is passing through zero, and why the emf alternates.

levels.descriptor: Methods are chosen and applied exactly, photon energies and flux changes are stated explicitly, and conclusions are justified without claiming brighter light ejects faster electrons.
levels.label: Secure

levels.descriptor: Method is correct in outline but a work-function, threshold or flux-change step is skipped.
levels.label: Developing

levels.descriptor: Methods are misapplied - for example claiming brighter light ejects faster electrons - and the working does not support the answer.
levels.label: Beginning
